articles.title: Replimune, Dell Technologies, NetApp And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher on Friday
articles.teaser: US stocks up, Dow Jones up 171 pts. Replimune Group rises after FDA agreement. Other big gainers include Dell, NetApp, and Okta.
articles.body:
U.S. stocks rose today, with the Dow Jones index rising around 171 points on Friday.

Shares of Replimune Group Inc. (NASDAQ:REPL) rose sharply after the company reached an agreement with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to advance the resubmission process for its experimental advanced melanoma treatment.

The FDA had declined to approve vusolimogene oderparepvec, or RP1, in April, and asked for more data from a well-controlled clinical trial. Replimune plans to resubmit its application to the regulator for the third time in the coming days.

Replimune Group surged 70.9% to $8.00 on Friday.

Here are some other big stocks recording gains in today's session.

  • Mega Fortune Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ:MGRT) gained 39.2% to $130.00, with a significant surge in daily trading volume, indicating that heightened retail and broad market participation is driving upward momentum.
  • Dell Technologies Inc. (NYSE:DELL) surged 33.7% to $423.75 after the company reported better-than-expected first-quarter financial results with the fastest quarterly revenue growth since 2018.
  • NetApp Inc. (NASDAQ:NTAP) climbed 27.2% to $181.18 after the company reported beat fourth-quarter results and higher-than-expected sales guidance for the first quarter.
  • TSS, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSSI) jumped 25.3% to $16.97.
  • PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) rose 21.8% to $9.06. RBC Capital analyst Matthew Hedberg raised PD's price target from $8.00 to $9.00 while maintaining a Sector Perform rating
  • Okta, Inc. (NASDAQ:OKTA) rose 18.5% to $112.28.
  • uniQure N.V. (NASDAQ:QURE) climbed 16.6% to $28.98.
  • Nextracker Inc. (NASDAQ:NXT) advanced 16.3% to $159.50.
  • Chagee Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:CHA) rose 16.1% to $11.80 after the company announced a $150 million share buyback program.

articles.author: erica kollmann
articles.title: PagerDuty Stock Rallies After Q1 Earnings Blow Past Estimates
articles.teaser: Here's a look inside the Q1 earnings report from PagerDuty.
articles.body:
PagerDuty Inc. (NYSE:PD) posted its first-quarter results after Thursday’s closing bell, beating estimates across the board. Here's a look at the details inside the report. 

  • PD stock is moving. Watch the price action here.

PagerDuty Q1 Details       

PagerDuty reported quarterly earnings of 32 cents per share, which blew past the analyst consensus estimate of 25 cents by 28%, according to Benzinga Pro data.

Quarterly revenue of $120.97 million beat the Street estimate of $119.6 million.

PagerDuty reported the following recent highlights:

  • ARR as of April 30, 2026, remained flat year over year at $496 million.
  • Customers with ARR over $100,000 grew 1% to 860 as of April 30, 2026, compared to 848 as of April 30, 2025.
  • Dollar-based net retention rate was 97% as of April 30, 2026, compared to 104% as of April 30, 2025.
  • Total paid customers were 15,380 as of April 30, 2026, compared to 15,247 as of April 30, 2025.
  • Paid and free customers totaled more than 36,000 as of April 30, 2026, representing approximately 14% growth since April 30, 2025.
  • Remaining performance obligations were $441 million as of April 30, 2026. Of this amount, the Company expects to recognize revenue of approximately $316 million, or 72%, over the next 12 months, $100 million, or 23%, over months 13 to 24, and the remainder thereafter.

Read Also: Trump Jr.'s Drone Stock Just Got A Pentagon Catalyst

“Our Q1 results exceeded guidance for both revenue and non-GAAP operating margin, reflecting continued execution against our strategic and operational priorities,” said Jennifer Tejada, executive chair, PagerDuty.

“Our expanding AI offers and the introduction of the new Operations Cloud usage-based package, further strengthens our platform and positions PagerDuty to accelerate long-term growth,” Tejada added.

PD Stock Price Activity: According to data from Benzinga Pro, Pager Duty stock climbed 12.90% to $8.40 in Thursday's extended trading.

This is a 33.33 percent increase over earnings of $0.24 per share from the same period last year.
